entity_raw.definition_raw:
Your failed attempt to humiliate a foe reveals its weaknesses to your allies.

Prerequisite(s): Half-orc.

Benefit(s): Whenever you fail a combat maneuver check, your allies within 30 feet who also have this feat gain a +2 circumstance bonus on combat maneuver checks of the same type against the same foe for 1 round.
